summary: Keep a word list that stores only lowercase English words, and support two calls. The first call records one new word. The second call brings a query in which every character is either a lowercase letter or a dot. A dot may stand in for any one lowercase letter and for exactly one position. Decide whether the list holds a word of the same length that agrees at every position. Write true when it does and false when it does not.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one command per line.
